newsitem.title: USA: Enstar distributes new stock to holders.
newsitem.headline: Enstar distributes new stock to holders.

text.p: The Enstar Group Inc said Thursday it had begun to distribute its new common stock to former shareholders of record as of June 1, 1992.
The holding company said it had to cancel its old common stock in 1992 as a result of its bankruptcy plan of reorgnization.
Shareholders will receive one new share for every 10 shares of old, cancelled stock, it said, adding they would get cash for fractional shares.
"Due to the unprecedented success of Enstar's operations under its bankruptcy plan, Enstar has paid off all creditors from its bankruptcy case," it said.
Enstar said it had scheduled its annual meeting for April 28, 1997.
